name: Viren Samani, personal profile
note: Recalibrated 21 September 2026, evening. Everything drafted before this point is deleted; it argued for the training instead of giving something away. Green accents from AI for Companies.
law: The post gives the thing away, completely, and never argues for what we sell.
Never mention training, sessions, a day, or the offer. The profile and the site convert, not the post.
No statistics about how badly people are doing. No 'X% of workers'. A number appears only when the reader can use it.
Everything in a post is real and usable today: a prompt that works, a method he runs, a thing that happened.
Plain English. If a word needs explaining outside tech, it is out.
One accent, the AI for Companies green. Photos of real rooms and people beat any graphic.
No hashtags, no question close, no former employer, no assistant.
